title: Glass engineering - designing and making photochromic glass
summary: Ben Krasnow of Applied Science shows how to make small batches of specialty glass with minimal equipment, including designing and making photochromic glass. He covers ingredients, melting and the challenges involved.
why: Recommended as a hands-on introduction to glass melting and chemistry and to Krasnow's channel.

quote.text: I'd highly recommend his channel to anyone interested in science and fabrication.
